intro.title: Our History
intro.description: Espacio Paihuen was founded in 2025 with the mission of providing an experience of peace and relaxation to everyone who visits. It has always focused on customer service and ensuring that your experience is the best possible in every aspect.

cabin.title: Cozy Cabins
cabin.description: Beautiful separate studio cabins for a unique experience

environment.title: Spectacular Surroundings
environment.description: Surrounded by trees, facing the sea, in a quiet and natural space

hot_tubs.title: Rustic Hot Tubs
hot_tubs.description: Private wood-fired hot tub for each cabin

environmental_commitment.title: Our Environmental Commitment
environmental_commitment.description_1: At Espacio Paihuen, we believe that true luxury is living in harmony with nature. That's why all our cabins run on solar energy, allowing you to enjoy all modern comforts without negatively impacting the environment.
environmental_commitment.description_2: Additionally, we have our own water well, which allows us to be completely self-sufficient and reduce our environmental footprint. Every drop of water we use comes from protected natural sources, ensuring the quality and sustainability of our operations.
environmental_commitment.description_3: Your stay with us contributes to the preservation of the environment, allowing you to travel with environmental awareness while enjoying maximum comfort in one of the most beautiful places in Chile.

header.label: Carretera Austral, Chile
header.title: About Us
header.subtitle: Discover the essence of Espacio Paihuen, where nature meets comfort

history.title: Our History
history.description_1: Espacio Paihuen is located on the beautiful Carretera Austral in southern Chile, surrounded by nature and stunning landscapes right in front of the sea. Our goal is to offer travelers a unique experience, combining the comfort of cozy accommodation with the natural beauty that surrounds us.
history.description_2: At Espacio Paihuen, we believe in the importance of connecting with nature and enjoying moments of tranquility in an inspiring setting. Come and discover everything we have to offer in this special corner of the world.

space.title: Our Space
space.description_1: We have a beautiful view of the sea and three cabins equipped with everything necessary for a comfortable and relaxing stay. Each cabin is designed to provide a cozy and harmonious atmosphere, allowing you to enjoy the natural beauty that surrounds us.
space.description_2: Additionally, we offer common areas where you can share special moments with other travelers or simply relax while contemplating the marine landscape. At Espacio Paihuen, we strive to create a warm and welcoming environment so that every guest feels at home during their stay with us.

cabins_detail.title: Our Cabins
cabins_detail.description_1: Our cabins are designed to offer you a unique and comfortable lodging experience. Each cabin features cozy and modern decor, equipped with all the necessary amenities to make your stay unforgettable.
cabins_detail.description_2: They are designed as studio-style spaces, featuring a spacious and well-lit interior. Each one has a large window facing nature and the sea. They also have a terrace to stay surrounded by nature, with a rustic hot tub for each cabin.
cabins_detail.description_3: Enjoy the tranquility of the natural environment while relaxing in your cabin, with stunning views of the sea and the surrounding nature. At Espacio Paihuen, we strive to provide you with a space where you can disconnect, recharge, and create unforgettable memories during your visit to the Carretera Austral.

tub.title: Personal Rustic Hot Tub
tub.info: Enjoy a sunset sitting in a hot tub overlooking the sea. Our tubs are wood-fired and private for each cabin. They are perfect for sharing a snack and a beautiful sunset.

kayak.title: Single and Double Kayak
kayak.info: Explore Quillaipe Bay in a single or double kayak. Enjoy the beautiful surroundings and the calm waters we have here, protected from strong waves.

central.title: Central Space
central.info: Relax in the open spaces and stroll through our beautiful Espacio Paihuen, enjoying the lovely birds like the Chilean Green-backed Firecrown that visit us every day.

cta.title: Ready for your Perfect Escape?
cta.subtitle: Come and discover the magic of Espacio Paihuen, where every moment becomes an unforgettable memory

header.label: Explore the Los Lagos Region
header.title: Nearby Attractions
header.message: Strategically located on the Carretera Austral, we are the perfect starting point to discover natural treasures.

alerce.title: Alerce Andino National Park
alerce.content: Just 30 minutes from Espacio Paihuen. Enjoy trekking trails surrounded by ancient Alerce trees and discover the magic of the Chaica Falls. A direct encounter with the Valdivian jungle.

caleta.title: Caleta La Arena
caleta.content: The starting point of the Carretera Austral, located 45 km from Puerto Montt. Known for its key ferry connection to Caleta Puelche and its famous local fried hake.

traditions.title: Route of Traditions
traditions.content: During the summer months on the Carretera Austral, enjoy southern culture by visiting traditional festivals. There is always delicious food like lamb roast, empanadas, and live folk music.

pvaras.title: Puerto Varas
pvaras.content: The "City of Roses" awaits you on the shores of Lake Llanquihue. Famous for its German-influenced architecture and unparalleled views of the Osorno and Calbuco volcanoes. Ideal for an afternoon of gastronomy and sightseeing.

chapo.title: Lake Chapo
chapo.content: An impressive mountain lake at the foot of the imposing Calbuco Volcano. The perfect place for those seeking wilder natural beauty and pure mountain air.

pichicolo.title: Pichicolo Hot Springs
pichicolo.content: A natural sanctuary for relaxation located before reaching Hornopirén. Ideal for those looking to disconnect and immerse themselves in native forest surroundings.

hornopiren.title: Hornopirén
hornopiren.content: Known as the "Northern Gateway to the Carretera Austral." This town combines the majesty of the Andes with the sea of the Patagonian fjords.

petrohue.title: Petrohué Falls
petrohue.content: One of Chile's most iconic natural attractions. These waterfalls stand out for their intense emerald waters flowing over basaltic lava formations.

cochamo.title: Cochamó Hot Springs
cochamo.content: Known for innovative thalassotherapy, merging thermal waters with seawater. They offer a premium experience in a native forest.

chiloe.title: Chiloé
chiloe.content: A magical archipelago famous for its unique cultural identity, wooden churches, and colorful stilt houses.

header.label: Carretera Austral Km 21.8
header.title: Where to Find Us
header.message: We are located at the beginning of the beautiful Carretera Austral, just 25 minutes from Puerto Montt.

directions.title: How to get here
steps: Leave Puerto Montt heading towards Carretera Austral.
Continue for 25 minutes until you reach Quillaipe.
At km 21.8, turn right (next to the Costa Quillaipe shop).
Follow the road to the end to reach Espacio Paihuen.

public_transport.title: Public Transport
public_transport.description: Take the <1>Buses Vargas</1> or <1>Buses J.B.</1> lines from the <2>Bus Terminal</2>. Frequent departures towards Caleta La Arena; ask to get off at <1>Quillaipe</1>.
